subject: English
question_text: Change the sentences according to directions. 1  10 =
stimulus: (a) Visiting a village is quite pleasant. (Negative) (b) I was born in a very big village. (Compound) (c) Doesn't our village stand on the Karotoa? (Interrogative) (f) My villagers get facilities but they are not sufficient. (Simple) (g) To a man, no other place is as beloved as his native village. subject: English
question_text: Change the sentences according to directions. 1  10 =
stimulus: (a) Mobile Phone is one of the most wonderful devices in the present world. (Make positive degree) (b) It is a very essential device for all classes of people. (Make negative sentence) (c) Though it is a blessing, it has some serious harmful aspects. (Make compound sentence) (d) It has changed our life style greatly. (Make passive voice) (e) It is a very unique thing indeed. (Make exclamatory sentence) (f) The importance of mobile phone cannot be described in words. (Make active voice) (g) Nothing is as useful as it. (Make comparative degree) (h) The modern world largely depends on it. (Make interrogative sentence) (i) Without using mobile phone we cannot communicate rapidly with others. (Make complex sentence) (j) We should use it consciously so that we can protect our eyesight. (Make simple sentence)

subject: English

(Make passive voice) (i) It is very essential but many people cannot afford it. (Make complex sentence) (j) People cannot buy it because of its high price. (Make compound sentence)
